column1: Engineering boundary: tier reactions are load-planning values for a shared support using the entered support spacing as tributary length. Automatic rod diameter selection is limited to the same reaction thresholds already used by the verified v1 BOM. Cross-member bending/deflection, cantilever moment, anchors, seismic bracing and building-structure capacity require verified manufacturer/project structural data and therefore remain explicit review gates.
